top.title: Israel mata alto comandante do Hamas em ataque aéreo na Faixa de Gaza
top.summary: Um ataque aéreo israelense matou nesta terça-feira (29) o chefe do braço armado do Hamas no norte de Gaza, disseram autoridades dos dois lados. O grupo terrorista o descreveu como um dos líderes do ataque de 7 de outubro de 2023 , que desencadeou a guerra no território palestino.

articles.title: Mourners in Gaza bury remains of loved ones killed in 2023 Israeli strike
articles.summary: Dozens of mourners in Gaza grieve the loss of their loved ones as they bury the fragmented remains of relatives killed.

articles.title: Two Palestinians killed and others injured in Israeli strike, gunfire in Gaza
articles.summary: An Israeli strike and gunfire killed two Palestinians and injured several others in Gaza on Tuesday, Wafa news reported. Medical sources at Al-Shifa Hospital told Wafa that the bodies of two Palestinians and several casualties, including children, were brought to the hospital following an Israeli air strike that targeted an apartment in the al-Nasr neighbourhood, north of Gaza City. articles.title: Gaza: One Palestinian killed, 13 wounded in Israeli attacks over 24 hours
articles.summary: One Palestinian was killed and 13 others were wounded in Israeli strikes in Gaza in the past 24 hours, the territory’s health ministry said in its daily report. Since the ceasefire began in October, at least 1,422 Palestinians have been killed and 4,996 wounded in Gaza, while 834 bodies have been recovered from under the rubble. This has raised the death toll since Israel launched its war on Gaza to 74,023 and the number of wounded to 175,111. Thousands remain buried under the rubble and are…

articles.title: Israeli drone strike kills Palestinian, wounds several others
articles.summary: Al Jazeera is reporting that at least one Palestinian was killed and several others left injured, including children, in the Israeli drone attack in al-Nasr neighbourhood, west of Gaza City.
